application_review: Translation of coefficient polynomials is an actual real algebra homomorphism. Its total degree does not increase, composition is addition of shifts, zero shift is identity, and evaluation commutes with the literal input shift.

The genuine graded coefficient Lie algebra is preserved: every supported lower-degree monomial has its coefficient in the required lower-central layer by antitonicity. Tensor substitution restricts to a Lie algebra automorphism, with the opposite shift as inverse, and exact evaluation compatibility.

The full native exponential array group is invariant under every integer input shift, witnessed by the actual shifted coefficient. The resulting original pointwise group automorphism and inherited-topology homeomorphism are constructed, with literal evaluation and additive composition formulas.

The exact all-integer original lattice is invariant in both directions. Actual nonnormal coset evaluation and input translation descend, are continuous, and commute by the literal z+v formula. Coset translations compose additively and form homeomorphisms with opposite shifts as inverses. No normality, substitute lattice or finite-only lattice condition is used.
Reviewed the degree shift: lower-central index is degree minus one, including constants. Degree reduction is handled by antitonicity rather than demanding invariance of each homogeneous piece.
Reviewed exact native membership: the translated coefficient witnesses the all-integer exponential array characterization, so no equality with the older polynomial-power generated group is assumed.

Reviewed nonnormal cosets: well-definedness uses the actual inverse-product left relation and lattice preservation. Inverses and composition are proved on representatives. Smoothness is not inferred from continuity.
Strict Lean checks and transitive axiom reports cover all new named declarations; prior proof sources and their axiom sets are retained. No independent kernel replay or full-target proof is claimed.

StrongConjecture and the original full finite monochromatic sums/products claim remain unproved. Finite-list native periodic interval inverse existence remains an explicit unproved hypothesis; its genuine existence proof and positive uniform correlation constants must be supplied. Conditional Prediction includes actual admissible parameters, positive finite scale-list closure, common native unit observables and complete fixed-ultrafilter calibration and count limits. Conditional Alignment includes the canonical finite-word schedule, actual execution, positive palette-scale budgets, common positive denominator and certified actual auxiliary visits. Integer realization now proves the actual master pair scale relation, exact natural numerator with its original rational value, canonical bounded full-modulus residues, all required divisibilities, uniform eventual fixed-integer divisibility, finite numerical slot bounds and the numerical own-target array-letter identity. The actual earlier-variable exposure fixes every residue and slot shift, full own-target numerators and array residues; exact affine tail dependence of each progression and the whole own-target progression sum is proved. Concrete integer-input polynomial array groups, their common nilpotence bound, input translations, pointwise lattice coset evaluation and exact affine model linear orbits are constructed. The genuine original native Lie polynomial-array coefficient algebra, bracket closure, high-degree cutoff and finite dimension are now proved; literal Lie evaluation homomorphisms and their lower-central compatibility are constructed. The same-step lower-central cutoff of the genuine array Lie algebra, injectivity of all integer evaluations and simultaneous coefficient recovery by one fixed finite integer evaluation set are now proved, including for the original native model. The actual binary product native Lie algebra, componentwise original exponential and global logarithm, and integration and inherited topology of every product Lie subalgebra are now proved. The complete native array coefficient algebra now embeds by one fixed finite family of integer inputs into the native Lie algebra of an actual finite original-group product. Its finite evaluation image integrates to a closed contractible simply connected subgroup, uniquely parameterized by coefficient exponentials. All-integer multiplication compatibility, the exact full exponential array subgroup, its group isomorphism and inherited-topology homeomorphism with the finite image, contractibility, simply connectedness, and discreteness of its pointwise Gamma-valued subgroup for discrete Gamma are now proved. Cocompactness of the exact all-integer pointwise lattice is now proved by actual lattice monomial spanning, rational-log intersection, positive-root character descent and continuous quotient transfer. The actual integrated subalgebra and full native array group now have constructed smooth manifold and Lie group structures on their inherited topologies, and all literal integer evaluations are smooth. The actual array group and exact lattice instantiate the existing NativeNilmanifoldData interface at the same original nilpotency step, with constructed compatible quotient metric. Integer input translations now preserve the actual graded coefficient Lie algebra, the full native exponential array group and its exact all-integer lattice; actual group and coset homeomorphisms and continuous coset evaluation with exact translation compatibility are proved. Smoothness of array input translations, smooth quotient charts and quotient evaluation maps, and identification with the model-orbit array construction remain unproved. HasAlignmentMonomialRecurrence remains an explicit unproved input. Its genuine nilpotent recurrence proof, the actual native polynomial-array model action with its required nilpotence and translation compatibility, microcell boundary and point-law estimates, and positive-probability Alignment bounds remain unproved. Final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction is incomplete. No unavoidable blocker is established. A complete public proof repository, official contribution PR, independent review and prize application remain pending; no completed prize submission is claimed.
